_meta.purpose: Full-brand website scan (visits) — domestic + foreign, from MD competitor list

read: Foreign cheongsam/qipao players dwarf VN designers online: Sau Lee ~152K, Shanghai Tang ~75K, Qipology ~23K — the modern-cheongsam/qipao category has a large English-search audience. Among VN, Xéo Xọ (mass áo dài) + Phan Huy (diaspora couture) lead; Công Trí strongest designer. These foreign brands are REFERENCE/channel benchmarks (P3), not consideration-set competitors — pull geo/channels/keywords next to see which sit on US/diaspora + the cheongsam keyword universe (relevant to Maison's sườn xám line).
